claim.signal: RFF ridge(less) return forecast: P=12,000 random Fourier features of 15 Goyal-Welch predictors
claim.universe: CRSP value-weighted market index (aggregate market timing)
claim.claimed_effect: out-of-sample market-timing Sharpe rises with model complexity (P), positive even in T=12 rolling windows with ridgeless regression
claim.source: Kelly, Malamud, Zhou (2024), 'The Virtue of Complexity in Return Prediction', Journal of Finance
claim.data_needs: Goyal-Welch predictor dataset (public) + CRSP market return (public via GYdata.mat)

protocol.replication_anchor: reproduce SR-vs-P curve, direction and magnitude, vs KMZ + two open-source replications (zivmi, nkonts)
protocol.kill_criteria_for_the_claim: if a simple mechanical alternative (kernel-weighted momentum) spans the strategy AND the strategy fails under counterfactuals (reversal world, content-destroying bootstrap), the complexity benefit is mechanical, not learned
protocol.seeds: >=5 RFF seeds; conclusions on the distribution

verdict.replication: PASS (Gate 5): SR 0.00->0.36 as P 2->12000; negative OOS R2 with positive timing SR; interpolation singularity at c=P/T=1

diagnostics.kernel_equivalence: RFF forecast vs Gaussian-kernel ridgeless forecast corr = 0.997; kernel spans strategy R2 = 0.995, residual alpha t = -0.85; weights decline with lag (recency corr +0.83 = momentum) and shrink with predictor vol (-0.41 = vol timing)
diagnostics.reversal_world: real SR +0.36 -> reversal SR -0.085, negative in 8/8 draws
diagnostics.wild_bootstrap: real SR +0.36 -> +0.378 unchanged after destroying predictive content

verdict.boundary: critique holds in the short-window ridgeless regime; phase diagram maps where the mechanism weakens as T grows
honest_limitations: simplified momentum proxy spans only 10% (alpha t=2.45); the rigorous demonstration is the kernel forecast, not the crude proxy
reversal/bootstrap parameters are pinned defaults, to be reconciled with Nagel's exact appendix
original construction has minor look-ahead ambiguities (infl contemporaneous; replication scaling window includes current month) worth ~0.02-0.04 SR; phenomenon survives either way
